backend-engineer.name: Backend Engineer
backend-engineer.description: Servers, databases aur APIs banayein jo web aur mobile apps ko chalate hain. Aap Python jaisi language seekh kar data models design karenge, services secure aur deploy karenge.

frontend-engineer.name: Frontend Engineer
frontend-engineer.description: Websites aur apps ke woh hisson ko banayein jo log dekhte aur use karte hain. Aap HTML, CSS, JavaScript aur React jaisa framework seekh kar speed aur accessibility par focus karenge.

fullstack-engineer.name: Full Stack Engineer
fullstack-engineer.description: Interface aur server dono par kaam karein. Aap poore products ship karenge, database aur API se screen tak, jo startups aur freelancing mein bohat qeemti hain.

mobile-app-developer.name: Mobile App Developer
mobile-app-developer.description: Android aur iPhone ke liye apps banayein. Aap Flutter ya React Native jaisa cross-platform toolkit seekh kar mobile screens design karenge aur app stores par publish karenge.

ai-engineer.name: AI Engineer
ai-engineer.description: Machine learning aur large language models se powered products banayein. Aap Python, ML fundamentals, AI APIs ke sath kaam karna aur AI features reliably ship karna seekhenge.

data-scientist.name: Data Scientist
data-scientist.description: Data ko decisions mein badlein. Aap data clean aur analyse karenge, statistical aur machine learning models banayenge aur results non-technical logon ko asani se samjhayenge.

cyber-security.name: Cybersecurity Analyst
cyber-security.description: Systems aur data ko attacks se bachayein. Aap networking, operating systems, common vulnerabilities seekh kar incidents detect, investigate aur respond karna seekhenge.

ui-ux-designer.name: UI/UX Designer
ui-ux-designer.description: Aise apps aur websites design karein jo asani se aur mazedar tareeke se use ho sakein. Aap user research, wireframing, visual design aur prototyping Figma mein seekh kar case studies ka portfolio banayenge.

devops-engineer.name: DevOps Engineer
devops-engineer.description: Software ke build, test aur deploy hone ke tareeqe automate karein. Aap Linux, scripting, CI/CD pipelines, containers, Kubernetes aur monitoring seekh kar kaam karenge.

cloud-engineer.name: Cloud Engineer
cloud-engineer.description: Cloud platforms jaise AWS par applications design aur run karein. Aap networking, compute, storage, security aur cost control seekh kar cloud certification ke liye tayar honge.

digital-marketer.name: Digital Marketer
digital-marketer.description: Search, social media, email aur ads ke zariye businesses online grow karein. Aap campaigns plan karna, content banana, results measure karna aur paid advertising chalana seekhenge.

graphic-designer.name: Graphic Designer
graphic-designer.description: Logos, social posts, posters aur brand identities banayein. Aap design principles, colour aur typography seekh kar professional tools use karenge aur client-ready portfolio banayenge.

video-editor.name: Video Editor
video-editor.description: YouTube, social media, ads aur clients ke liye videos edit karein. Aap cutting, pacing, audio, colour aur motion basics seekh kar deadline par polished kaam deliver karenge.

content-creator.name: Content Creator
content-creator.description: Apni audience banayein aur YouTube, Instagram, TikTok ya blog par apne content se kamaai karein. Aap niche selection, scripting, filming, editing, growth aur monetisation seekhenge.
